sources.head: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE separate modular pixel-art game asset: only the HEAD of original monster Rumigaru, following reference identity. Face RIGHT, exact side view. Broad wedge-shaped indigo forehead, enormous ivory shield-shaped lower jaw, two stout ivory fangs, dark angular mouth. NO eyes (leave solid indigo area in upper right half for separate eyes), NO antenna, NO fins, NO body, NO tail. Flat 10-color hard pixel art, designed to reduce to only 28 pixels wide by 27 tall. Strong clean silhouette, large color blocks, NO dithering, NO gradients, NO glow, NO shadow outside sprite. Transparent background. Head fills canvas with small transparent margin. Palette dark navy outline, indigo shadow and blue highlights, warm ivory jaw and tan jaw shadows. The left attachment edge should be broad and solid, so head can overlap a fish body. No text.
sources.body: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE standalone modular sprite asset: fish BODY of original Rumigaru in reference, facing RIGHT in strict SIDE VIEW. Only compact oval indigo fish torso with 3 broad curved turquoise gill markings and short integrated fan tail on LEFT. RIGHT edge blunt and rounded attachment for separate oversized head. No head, no mouth, no eyes, no legs, no pectoral fins, no antenna, no dorsal fin. Crisp extremely simple 10-color pixel art, designed to reduce to 31 pixels wide by 23 pixels tall. Large flat pixel clusters and bold navy outline. Indigo main, blue highlight, midnight navy shadow, turquoise gills, light blue tail edge. Transparent background, no glow or gradients or drop shadow. Fill canvas with small margin. Do not draw the whole monster, torso and tail only. No text.
sources.arms: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE isolated modular sprite asset: a SINGLE broad pectoral FIN of original Rumigaru fish reference. Attachment at TOP RIGHT, long tapered fan points BOTTOM LEFT. Three broad navy-blue fin rays with muted light blue edges. No torso, no fish, no face, no other parts. Very simple crisp pixel art for a game asset that will be reduced to 16x12 pixels. Flat indigo, midnight navy, light blue; 5 colors maximum, big bold pixel clusters, no dithering, no gradients, no glow, no shadows outside shape. Transparent background. Fill canvas with small transparent margin. No text.
sources.horns: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE isolated modular sprite asset: the fishing-lure antenna of original Rumigaru fish reference, no creature. An inverted arch of thick INDIGO stalk, rises from LOWER LEFT, curves over at top, terminates in a small amber TWO-PRONG FORK at RIGHT. Bottom left attachment connects to head; yellow fork is the farthest right. Compact broad arch. Only this antenna, no head, no eyes, no face, no fins, no body. Very simple crisp pixel art to be reduced to 18 pixels wide by 17 pixels tall, thick 2-pixel-wide stalk and strong readable fork with gap between prongs. Flat dark navy outline, indigo, blue highlight, amber and ivory, maximum 6 colors. Transparent background. No glow, gradients, dithering, or exterior shadow. Fill canvas with small margin. No text.
